title: HippoRAG-style multi-hop graph activation benchmark
retriever_under_test: keyword_fts5_only (in-process, deterministic; recency and the cross-encoder disabled so the only variable is the graph propagation). Reruns identically on the live WSL2 memory-venv (real numpy/fastembed, RTX 5080).

mechanism.description: Bounded personalised PageRank over the record<->entity graph (entity_links). Seeds are the fused top-k records; relevance diffuses along shared entities so a fact linked only through an intermediate bridge (a different entity, or a record joining two entities) surfaces even when it shares no entity with a direct hit.
mechanism.default_state: ENABLED BY DEFAULT as the standard behaviour (the previous bounded one-hop entity expansion is subsumed). Damping 0.6, hops 2, channel weight 0.3, per-node degree caps (record 6 / entity 16) bound a hub, and ties break on id. Pure SQL with no external dependency, so it always degrades gracefully to the direct hits; confirmed-identity bridges are still folded in as a second bounded source.

runtime: WSL2 Ubuntu, memory-venv python 3.12.3, torch 2.11.0+cu128, RTX 5080 (numbers reproduced identically on Windows CPython 3.13.13)

after.label: multi-hop personalised PageRank, production default (--mode multi)

delta.two_hop_activation_recall: 0.0 -> 1.0 (multi-hop reaches term-less bridges the one-hop expansion cannot)
delta.one_hop_activation_recall: 1.0 -> 1.0 (multi-hop is a strict superset; nothing is lost)
delta.direct_recall: 1.0 -> 1.0 (the lever never demotes a direct answer)

relevance_gate_finding: two_hop_in_episodes_recall stays 0.0 in every mode under the keyword-only harness. The hard RelevanceGate (relevance.py) accepts a hydrated candidate only on `lexical OR semantic>=0.5`, so a candidate activated purely by graph structure - sharing no query term and no embedding neighbourhood - is correctly refused at the answer surface. The propagation therefore enlarges the reachable CANDIDATE set (proven above) and enriches the `connections` provenance, but its end-to-end recall benefit is gated until a bridge is also lexically or semantically relevant. This is a deliberate anti-hallucination boundary, not a defect.
interpretation: Rank fusion and vector/ANN channels only ever return records that already overlap the query by term or embedding. The only way to surface a fact relevant purely because of how it CONNECTS is graph propagation, and this benchmark shows two-hop personalised PageRank activating exactly those (0.0 -> 1.0) while remaining a strict superset of one-hop and never disturbing a direct answer. Realising the candidate-level activation at the final answer surface would require loosening the RelevanceGate to accept graph-provenanced bridges - a safety-relevant change to the anti-hallucination guard that was intentionally NOT made here.

regression.full_unittest_suite: Ran 178 tests OK (skipped=21) on the WSL2 memory-venv
